subtitle: A meal plan your AI fills with dinners and groceries.
about: A note with a week of dinners, who cooks and a grocery checklist grouped by aisle. Tell your AI which nights you're cooking to plan both, or fill in the days yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the meal plan and groceries template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.you: Plan dinners for the week. Oskar cooks Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday. We're out on Saturday.
slides.ai: The week is in the Dinners table, and what it needs is under Groceries, by aisle.
slides.alt: Meal plan and groceries filled in, in Pinto Notes on a Mac

slides.label: Tick the groceries
slides.ai: Ticked it on the grocery list.
slides.alt: Groceries, in Meal plan and groceries

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
